SHA-512 (npm integrity): Yzr5xG7ZwbtA50IYAU1k/oSoSyDAhPtT5qC/Q2eFApoLuAYE8DQbPIMPs/0kh4Ietd4P0OpKk3CIkfNqjcr56g==

core.js bundles the npm dist/esm modules RP2040, SimulationClock, and FUNCTION_SIO
with esbuild 0.25.12, --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --target=es2022
--legal-comments=inline. The unused getCurrentMicroseconds() function is removed
from utils/time.js before bundling to exclude its dynamic Node require fallback.
LICENSE.txt is unchanged. GDB/network tooling and demo assets are excluded.
worker.js is the lab's local driver and has no remote network dependency.
